text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Integration
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Claude Code Action
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          allowed_bots: false
          allowed_non_write_users: true
          include_comments_by_actor: false
          exclude_comments_by_actor: "claude[bot],github-actions[bot]"
          prompt: |
            You are a senior C#/.NET developer working on a Blazor application called PKMDS-Blazor.
            
            Your tasks:
            1. For issue/PR comments starting with "@claude", provide helpful responses
            2. When asked to implement features, follow these guidelines:
               - Add Claude Code integration (triggered on @claude mentions)
               - Implement PID generator UX improvements (consolidate buttons with constraint checkboxes)
               - Fix bug report Submit() method to guard against bypassed client-side validation
            
            Always respond in a clear, technical manner with specific code examples when implementing changes.
            
            Remember: This is a Blazor project in C#, so all implementations should be in C# and Blazor syntax.
          settings: |
            {
              "auto_approve": true,
              "auto_merge": false
            }
```
